meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能用浏览器自动打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据等,并且页面状态在多次操作间保持。
howto.when: 当用户提出打开网页、填写表单、抓取数据等浏览器操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截一张整页图
say.note: 会启动浏览器打开该网址并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我点击页面里的搜索按钮,并填入关键词
say.note: 会先读取页面元素快照再操作。

say.text: 把当前页面上的新闻标题抓下来
say.note: 会编写脚本抓取并返回标题列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a browser to open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and keeps page state between operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to open a page, fill in a form, scrape data, or similar browser interactions.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Starts the browser, opens the URL, and saves the screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the search button and fill in a keyword.
say_en.note: Reads the page element snapshot first, then acts.

say_en.text: Scrape the news headlines from this page.
say_en.note: Runs a script and returns the headline list.
